big_case.notes: Formed before reading any candidate's big_case_score. A single Washington legislative district (LD 15), a procedural Article III mootness question, an unpublished three-page memorandum below, and a disposition that turned out to be a one-line GVR in light of Louisiana v. Callais. The petition's significance is derivative of Callais and of the linked Soto Palmer / Trevino litigation rather than its own; the sequencing problem (a single-judge VRA remedy mooting a three-judge-court Equal Protection claim) recurs in redistricting litigation, which keeps this above a routine petition but well short of a headline case.
